WITH event_avg AS (
    SELECT e.event_name, AVG(b.amount) as avg_amount 
    FROM budget b 
    JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id 
    WHERE b.amount IS NOT NULL 
    GROUP BY e.event_name
),
overall_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_amount) as overall_average
    FROM event_avg
),
kept_events AS (
    SELECT ea.event_name, ea.avg_amount
    FROM event_avg ea, overall_avg oa
    WHERE ea.avg_amount > oa.overall_average
),
kept_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_amount) as kept_average
    FROM kept_events
)
SELECT 
    ke.event_name,
    ke.avg_amount,
    ke.avg_amount - oa.overall_average as diff_from_overall,
    ke.avg_amount / ka.kept_average as ratio_to_kept_avg
FROM kept_events ke, overall_avg oa, kept_avg ka
ORDER BY ke.avg_amount DESC
